scope: Independent public candidate seed/receipt/transaction/block arithmetic; trusted local scoped-clock and process observations are not portable facts.
limitations: The exported chain is a retained pre-reorg canonical observation, not continuous or current consensus.
Block parsing, Merkle/witness commitments and normal hashes are independently checked; full script/consensus admission was exercised by the separate owned nodes.
Captured timestamps, process ownership and exact reorg timing remain trusted local test evidence.
No official signing key, wallet file, node RPC or portable ownership authority is consumed.
received_compact_record_digest binds incoming compact field order; it is not asserted to be canonical RecordDigest for reordered input.
